component.name: Osiris
component.summary: An AI agent that works over a folder of yours

description.p: Osiris is an AI assistant that works in a workspace: a folder you choose. It reads and writes the files there, searches your documents, remembers facts, runs scheduled tasks and uses the tools, rules and MCP servers the workspace configures in its .osiris folder.
It talks to any OpenAI-compatible model API with your own key. The same agent runs in this desktop app, in the terminal and on a server.
